verdict.probe_answer: Both arms add the requested precedence test, and that test would fail against the pre-change behavior once adapted to the old API because comment-only typed content would not fall back to title and the title tier did not exist. As written, both also fail to compile on pre-change code because they call the new 4-argument API. The strongest test in both arms is the comment-only typed -> title case, which directly targets RR2-FIX-5. The weakest in both is the typed-wins case, because it asserts only `.0` and not `CommitSource::Typed`; both suites also miss typed-over-file, comment-only file, NUL stripping, and typed/file 64KiB sanitization.
